reuse.why: Reads last month's spending from the sheet's sum-amount cell via the existing getSheetValue and reuses setBudget/batchMessages/undoable, but parses the #fixed tag with its own regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The four copied category-selection queries collapse into getMonthWideCategories; the only new duplication is the hand-written tag regex, plus the income/tracking skip and sign flip repeated per action as before.

placement.why: Selection helper and the new action sit in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and the method is registered in budget/app.ts; tag parsing belongs in shared/tags.ts rather than a local regex.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, the new method, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: A single selection function owns hidden/template/#fixed exclusions behind one named flag; the private tag regex can disagree with how the rest of the app recognises tags.

bypasses_abstraction.where: hasFixedTag in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts uses its own /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ regex instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags

disguised_duplication.where: The tag regex is a separate reimplementation of tag extraction rather than a reshaped copy; the selection copies were genuinely merged.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter toggling the hidden SQL filter; copyPreviousMonth (via allowedIds), setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg all route through it.
